summary: Deliverable is fundamentally incomplete and cannot run. Missing critical files: tests/ directory (pytest expects it but workflow will fail), fixtures/license-policy.json, fixtures/license-db.json, and initial fixtures/package.json. Workflow references these via env vars and pytest, but they don't exist—act will fail immediately. Python code lacks type hints (best practice for py3.12+). Version parsing with .lstrip("^~=") is fragile and doesn't handle all semver formats robustly. run_act_tests.py is well-designed for its purpose (proper subprocess/file handling, clear test structure) but cannot execute without fixtures. License_checker.py is readable and well-structured with good error handling, but cannot be validated against actual workflow execution. Task explicitly requires "ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT" but no tests exist and workflow will crash on pytest step.
